cards.text:
眼睛已经睁不开了
可就是不想睡
cards.en:
Your eyes are closing.
You still don't want to sleep.

cards.text:
心理学里有个词
叫“睡前拖延”
cards.small: Kroese 等人于 2014 年提出
cards.en:
Psychologists have a name for it:
“bedtime procrastination.”

cards.text:
白天的时间
大多排给了别人
cards.en:
Most of your day
is scheduled by other people.

cards.text:
只有睡前这一小段
完全归你自己
cards.en:
This last stretch before bed
is the only part that's all yours.

cards.text:
你舍不得睡
是舍不得这点“说了算”
cards.en:
You're not hanging on to the night.
You're hanging on to being in charge.

cards.text:
那就在白天
也给自己留一小块
cards.en:
So keep a small piece
of the day for yourself, too.
